name: Six
author: Steffen Mühlhäuser / Steffen-Spiele (2003) — AGP port
description: Steffen Mühlhäuser's boardless hexagon game (Steffen-Spiele, 2003): the tiles ARE the playing area. Lay your 20 tokens next to the growing cluster, then start picking your own tokens up and re-laying them — a pickup that cuts the field apart CAPTURES every group but the largest, your own tokens included. Win by getting six of your colour into a row, a triangle or a circle, or by cutting your opponent below six tokens.
